claims: The World Baseball Classic launched in 2006.
The World Baseball Classic is sanctioned by the WBSC.
The World Baseball Classic features MLB and international league players.
The World Baseball Classic was created to promote global baseball.
Japan leads with three World Baseball Classic titles.
Venezuela won the 2026 World Baseball Classic.
In 2006, Japan won the inaugural World Baseball Classic tournament by defeating Cuba.
In 2009, Japan won the World Baseball Classic by beating South Korea.
In 2013, the Dominican Republic won the World Baseball Classic title undefeated.
In 2017, the United States won its first World Baseball Classic championship by defeating Puerto Rico.
In 2023, Japan won a third World Baseball Classic title in the final against the U.S.
Shohei Ohtani was named MVP of the 2023 World Baseball Classic.
In 2026, Venezuela defeated the United States 3-2 to win its first World Baseball Classic title.
Garcia was named MVP of the 2026 World Baseball Classic.
The 2021 World Baseball Classic event was delayed to 2023 due to COVID-19.
The World Baseball Classic field expanded from 16 to 20 teams for the 2023 tournament.
The 2026 World Baseball Classic USA-Dominican Republic semifinal set a new record for the most-watched WBC broadcast.
The World Baseball Classic shifted to a mostly four-year cycle.
